# NewsHub - Real-time News Aggregation Platform

> NewsHub is a high-performance, real-time news aggregator providing globally unified news, tech trends, hot topics, and customizable RSS feed tracking.

## Core Features & Sections
- [Homepage](https://205077.xyz/): Real-time news matrix aggregating multi-source global updates.
- [Focus Column](https://205077.xyz/c/focus): Highlighted breaking news and curated top stories.
- [Hottest Trending](https://205077.xyz/c/hottest): Real-time aggregated trending topics across major platforms (Weibo, Zhihu, V2EX, GitHub, Hacker News, etc.).
- [Realtime Stream](https://205077.xyz/c/realtime): Minute-by-minute streaming news dispatch.
- [News Directory](https://205077.xyz/c/news): Comprehensive category breakdown (Tech, Finance, Entertainment, Science, General).
- [Custom Sources](https://205077.xyz/c/more): Custom RSS source subscription and channel configuration.
- [About & E-E-A-T](https://205077.xyz/about): Project mission, architecture, privacy compliance, and LLM citation guidelines.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- [llms-full.txt](https://205077.xyz/llms-full.txt): Complete structured text catalog & LLM knowledge base.
- [Sitemap](https://205077.xyz/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for automated indexing.
- [Robots](https://205077.xyz/robots.txt): Machine crawler permission rules.
